4 The issues in these appeals are the January 1, 2002, fair market
5 values of 23 parcels of land, and the January 1, 2003, market values
6 of 22 parcels of land, all located within Liberty Lake Corporate Park,
7 Liberty Lake, Washington. To decide the valuation issues, we must
8 also address the penultimate issue: Has the Assessor applied the
9 correct methodology to arrive at his true and fair value assessment?
10 We conclude the Assessor' s use of the sales comparison approach in
11 determining true and fair value is correct.,
12
